Mrs. Lata Negi, Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Aayush Gaur, Advocate, for the respondent.
The parties are present in person, who has been duly identified by their respective counsels.

The parties are under litigation for the offences under sections 498A and 506 of IPC, and under sections  of the Dowry Prohibition Act, which stands registered by way of a Criminal Case No.148 of 2023,
"State Vs. Shivam Diwakar and others", which is presently pending consideration before the court of Judicial Magistrate, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.text: State Vs. Shivam Diwakar and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As a resultant of the issuance of the summoning order which was issued by the court of Judicial Magistrate, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar on 21.02.2023.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The same has been put to challenge in the present C482 application, which is supported with the compounding application, which has been duly signed by all the parties, including their respective counsels, wherein, initially it was contended that the parties are proposing to file the proceedings under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, and they have decided to live separately, but in the absence of the actual proceedings under section 13B of the Act, being instituted, compounding application was not considered on the previous date i.e. 09.08.2023.

Today when the matter was taken up, learned counsel for the applicants have placed before this Court the questionnaire, as he has procured from the court of Family Judge, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar, in which the questions, which has been sought for has been answered by the court concerned that the inter se dispute between the parties, there happens to be proceedings under section 13B of the Act, registered as Petition No.297 of 2023, "Suman Vs. Shivam Divakar",
and the same is pending consideration before the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Rudrapur,

Since the parties have already resolved that they are seeking dissolution of their marriage, as it was solemnized on 07.03.2019, they are acceptable to the fact, that in case if the proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case are dropped, they will not be having any grievances, as such, because they want to settle all the issues, in the pending proceedings under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act.

entities.text: Family Judge, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Owing to the aforesaid statement made by the complainant/respondent no.2, who is present before this Court with whom the Court has interacted and having recorded their statement, this Court is of the view that the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.148 of 2023, "State Vs. Shivam Diwakar and others", pending consideration before the court of Judicial Magistrate, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar, deserves to be quashed.

entities.text: State Vs. Shivam Diwakar and others

sentences.text: Accordingly, owing to the fact that the parties are under litigation under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, no fruitful purpose would be solved, to keep the C482 application pending.

Hence,
owing to the above reasons, the C482 application would stand dropped.
